mentions.name: Victorious
mentions.description: This tool generates custom visualizations to help users mentally prepare for big moments, such as sports competitions, performances, public speaking, job interviews, and hard conversations. Inspired by a tape of a fake news broadcast that Seve listened to before winning the Masters, it lets users create similar success visualizations to build confidence and counter negative self-talk.
mentions.problem: Negative self-talk and low confidence before high-stakes moments; the author noticed this in his own golf game after a poor streak on the course.
mentions.audience: People preparing for big moments such as sports competitions, performances, public speaking, job interviews, and difficult conversations.
mentions.source_excerpt: I built a tool that generates custom visualizations to prepare for big moments: http://bevictorious.co/
